head_commit.message:
Fix config documentation: correct TOML parsing description

The CLI help text and inline comments incorrectly stated that -c key=value
flag parses values as JSON, when the implementation actually uses TOML parsing
via parse_toml_value(). This caused confusion when users attempted to configure
MCP servers using JSON syntax based on the documentation.

Changes:
- Updated help text to correctly state TOML parsing instead of JSON
- Fixed inline comment to match actual implementation
- Added informative warning when TOML parsing fails for complex values
- Warning guides users to use TOML syntax and explains the fallback behavior

Fixes #4531

v0.14.0

Added Features

  • Implement Values on tuple by @​GuillaumeGomez in askama-rs/askama#391

Further Changes

  • Move FastWritable into askama root by @​GuillaumeGomez in askama-rs/askama#411

New Contributors
